mapper.select: select id, store_code, store_name, sku_code, goods_name, inventory_upper_limit, inventory_lower_limit, min_inventory_upper_limit, min_inventory_lower_limit, is_auto_replenishment, creator, create_time, updater, update_time, is_delete from gc_replenishment_config where is_delete =0 and is_auto_replenishment=1 and biz_org_code=#{bizOrgCode} and store_code=#{storeCode}

SELECT id, store_code, store_name, begin_time, end_time, org_code,biz_org_code, create_time, creator, updater, update_time, is_invalid, is_delete from gc_replenishment_store_disabled_range where DATE_FORMAT(now(),'%Y-%m-%d') between begin_time and end_time and store_code = #{storeCode} and biz_org_code = #{bizOrgCode} and is_invalid = #{isInvalid} and is_delete = #{isDelete}

#{item}
